metadata.title: TAMAS — AI Business Assistant for MSMEs in Bali
metadata.description: Record your income and spending in a sentence, then ask an AI Advisor where your money goes and what to change. Free, in Bahasa Indonesia or English.

hero.title: The expense tracker you can ask questions
hero.body: Record your income and spending in a sentence. TAMAS's AI Advisor reads your own numbers and tells you where your salary goes and what you could change, in plain Bahasa Indonesia or English.
hero.note: No bank login needed. Only you can see your transactions.

preview.answerTop: Most of it goes to food: {food}, a third of everything you spent this month ({expense}).
preview.answerBottom: The good news: you still kept {saved}, or {rate}% of your salary, above the {target}% target. Want more room? Cap shopping at {shoppingCap} and you'll have an extra {trim} every month.
preview.caption: Example answer from a sample month: {income} income, {expense} spent.

howItWorks.title: From one sentence to a plan, in three steps
howItWorks.body: No spreadsheets and no bank login. You decide what goes in, and TAMAS helps you make sense of it.

quickEntry.title: Write it the way you'd say it
quickEntry.body: Type a sentence in Bahasa Indonesia or English. TAMAS fills in the amount, category and date for you, or you can use the regular form.

savings.title: See your month at a glance
savings.body: Your dashboard shows your balance and how much of this month's income you've kept, measured against a {target}% savings target.

starterQuestions.title: Ask the Advisor about it
starterQuestions.body: Open the AI Advisor from any page and ask about your own numbers. Not sure what to ask? Start with one of the suggested questions.

advisor.title: Questions you'd ask a friend who's good with money
advisor.body: The Advisor reads your profile and the transactions you've recorded, then answers with your own figures and one practical next step. Here is what it says about a typical first-job month.

biggest.question: Where does most of my money go?
biggest.answer: Food, at {food}. That's a third of everything you spent this month.

trend.question: Is my spending going up?
trend.answer: Yes. You spent {increase} more than last month ({previous}), and most of the increase is eating out.

cut.question: What could I cut without feeling it?
cut.answer: Shopping is the easiest to trim. Bringing it from {shopping} to {shoppingCap} frees {trim} a month, or {trimYear} a year.

emergencyFund.question: When will my emergency fund be ready?
emergencyFund.answer: Three months of expenses is {target}. Saving {saved} a month gets you there in {months} months, or {monthsWithTrim} if you also trim shopping.

privacy.title: You choose what the Advisor can see
privacy.body: One setting in your Profile, on or off any time. When it's off, your transactions never reach the Advisor.

modes.personal: For questions about your money: totals, categories, trends and how close you are to your goal.
modes.general: General guidance only: how big an emergency fund should be, deposits versus money market funds, how to start investing.

noBankLogin.title: No bank login
noBankLogin.body: You add transactions yourself. TAMAS never asks for your bank or e-wallet password.

onlyYou.title: Only you can read your records
onlyYou.body: Every transaction is tied to your account, and the database refuses requests from anyone else.

realFigures.title: Figures from your records
realFigures.body: With data access on, the Advisor looks up your transactions before answering and says which period a number covers. It doesn't guess totals.

free.question: Is TAMAS free?
free.answer: Yes. Creating an account, recording transactions and asking the Advisor are free.

bank.question: Do I need to connect my bank account?
bank.answer: No. You add transactions yourself, by typing a sentence or filling in a short form. Nothing is pulled from your bank or e-wallet.

beginner.question: I'm new to managing money. Is this for me?
beginner.answer: It's built for exactly that. Record what comes in and goes out, and ask the Advisor anything in everyday words, like "why does my money run out so fast?". No finance vocabulary needed.

languages.question: Which languages does TAMAS speak?
languages.answer: The app is in English or Bahasa Indonesia; switch any time from the menu at the top or in Profile. The Advisor replies in the language you write in, and uses Bahasa Indonesia if it can't tell.

visibility.question: Who can see my transactions?
visibility.answer: Only you. Each transaction belongs to your account, and the database rejects requests from anyone else. Turn off the Advisor's data access in Profile and it doesn't read them at all.

advice.question: Is the Advisor professional financial advice?
advice.answer: No. It helps you understand your own numbers and suggests practical next steps. For big decisions like a loan or a large investment, talk to a licensed financial planner too.

closing.title: Start with this month's salary
closing.body: Record your income, add a few expenses, and ask the Advisor your first question. It takes about five minutes.

metadata.title: TAMAS - Privacy Policy
metadata.description: What TAMAS collects, why, who processes it, and your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: TAMAS is an AI business assistant for MSMEs in Bali, run by {operator}. This policy explains what we collect, why, who processes it for us, and the rights you have under Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU No. 27 Tahun 2022).

beta.title: During the beta: AI on Google Gemini's free tier
beta.body: While TAMAS is in beta, its AI features run on the free tier of the Google Gemini API. Under Google's terms for that tier, Google may use what TAMAS sends to improve its products, and people at Google may review it. We recommend using sample data, or leaving out details you would rather keep private. Before TAMAS leaves beta we will move to Gemini's paid tier, where Google does not use this content to improve its products, and update this policy.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.account: Account: your email address and password (stored hashed by our authentication provider), or the name, email and picture Google shares when you sign in with Google; and a username.
collect.profile: Profile answers you choose to give: monthly income, birth year, main financial goal, number of dependents, whether you have debt.
collect.records: Your records: transactions (amount, type, category, description, date).
collect.conversations: AI Advisor conversations: your questions and the Advisor's answers, so you can return to them. They are kept until you delete the conversation or your account.
collect.settings: Settings: your language and whether the AI Advisor may use your data.
collect.usage: AI usage records: when you used an AI feature and how many tokens it took, to enforce fair-use limits and measure cost. Not the content of your messages.
collect.analytics: Product analytics: events such as “signed up”, “transaction created” or “advisor answer rated”, linked to a random account ID. They never include amounts, descriptions or profile answers.
collect.noSale: We never ask for bank or e-wallet logins, and we do not sell your data or show ads.

use.title: How we use it
use.run: To run the app: save and show your records.
use.ai: To power AI features: turning a sentence into transactions, answering your questions, and searching your records.
use.safety: To keep the service safe and within fair-use limits.
use.improve: To understand which features help, so we can improve TAMAS.

processors.title: Who processes your data for us
processors.gemini: Google (Gemini API): the text you type into quick entry and the AI Advisor, and every transaction you save (type, category, description, amount, date), which is turned into a search index so the Advisor can find it. When “Let AI Advisor use my data” is on, the Advisor also receives your profile answers and the transactions it looks up to answer you. You can turn that off in Profile at any time.
processors.googleSignIn: Google (Sign in with Google): only if you choose to sign in with Google.
processors.posthog: PostHog: the product analytics events described above.
processors.abroad: Some of these providers process data outside Indonesia. We use them only to provide TAMAS.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep your data while you have an account. When you delete your account in Profile, your profile, records, Advisor conversations, settings and AI usage records are deleted immediately. You can also delete a single conversation from the Advisor's history at any time. To have your analytics events deleted as well, contact us.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.access: See and take your data: download all your transactions as a CSV file in Profile.
rights.correct: Correct it: edit any transaction or profile answer.
rights.delete: Delete it: delete single records, or your whole account in Profile.
rights.withdraw: Withdraw consent: turn off the AI Advisor's data access in Profile.
rights.contactEmail: For anything else, or to file a complaint, email us at <link>{email}</link>.
rights.contactPending: For anything else, or to file a complaint, contact us. A contact email will be listed here before the beta opens.

security.title: Security
security.body: Every record is tied to your account, and the database refuses requests for anyone else's data. Traffic is encrypted with HTTPS, and keys that can bypass these rules never leave our servers.

age.title: Age
age.body: TAMAS is meant for people aged 18 and over.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: When we change this policy we update the date above, and tell you in the app when the change affects what we collect or who processes it.

balance.description: Recorded income minus expenses, not your bank balance

reminders.empty: Start by recording your salary and a few daily expenses. A month of tracking shows where your money really goes.
reminders.negative: You've spent more than you've earned so far. Pick one expense to cut this week, starting with your biggest category.
reminders.highSpending: More than 80% of your income is going out. Aim for 50% needs, 30% wants and 20% savings.

habits.payYourselfFirst: Pay yourself first: move your savings to a separate account on payday, before the spending starts.
habits.emergencyFund: Build an emergency fund of 3 to 6 months of expenses before putting money into riskier investments.
habits.debtLimit: Keep loan and installment payments under 30% of your income, so one bad month doesn't snowball.
habits.subscriptions: Check your subscriptions once a month. Small recurring charges add up quietly.
habits.paylater: Paylater is still debt. Count every installment as part of next month's budget.
habits.investHorizon: Only invest money you won't need for 3 to 5 years. Money for sooner goals belongs in savings or a money market fund.
